name: POST /api/notifications/dispatch — dedup window + cap opt-in, legacy path unchanged
description: The existing unified dispatch transport, now accepting four OPTIONAL fields — purpose, respect_frequency_cap, dedup_key, auto_dedup — that enable the P16 frequency cap and no-answer dedup window. Proves AC2 and AC3. AC3 is a property of the shape: a caller that supplies none of the four never reaches the guard at all and takes exactly the path it took before, writing nothing to the send ledger — every pre-existing notification endpoint (send, templates, quiet-hours, providers, sms-settings, sms-consent, delivery-receipts, inbound webhooks) is untouched, and the dispatch contract is additive rather than modified. AC2: with auto_dedup (or an explicit dedup_key), a retry of the SAME message inside the window returns status 'suppressed' with blocked_by 'dedup' instead of producing a duplicate burst; the check is an INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING against a partial unique index, so concurrent retries cannot both decide they are first — a read-then-write check would let exactly that happen under the retry storm this exists to stop. QA edge cases: the guard runs AFTER quiet hours, because a deferred send has not happened and reserving a cap unit for it would charge the tenant for a message still to come; a FAILED provider send releases the reservation, so an outage cannot burn the daily allowance on messages nobody received and then have the window block the retry meant to fix it; dedup is evaluated BEFORE the cap, so a retry of a message that already went out is reported as a duplicate rather than as a cap denial — 'cap reached' would tell the caller their message did not send when it did; a different body to the same recipient is a different send and is not collapsed; blocked_by distinguishes 'dedup' from 'cap' so a caller can tell 'already sent' from 'you are over your limit'.

testCases.name: Legacy call with no opt-in behaves exactly as before
Opting into dedup suppresses an identical retry
Opting into the cap on a capped channel

errorCases.name: A missing required dispatch field is refused
errorCases.message: tenant_id, channel, destination and body are required
errorCases.when: any of tenant_id, channel, destination or body is absent — unchanged from before this feature

errorCases.name: An unsupported channel is refused
errorCases.message: channel must be one of email, sms, whatsapp, push, slack
errorCases.when: channel is outside the supported dispatch set — unchanged from before this feature

errorCases.name: Unauthenticated is refused by the default-deny gate
errorCases.when: no valid tenant Bearer token or tenant-scoped API key on the request
